[B] TEST SELECTOR ISSUE — The test successfully finds the "New In" parent link, but the timeout occurs while waiting for a *different* element: an anchor matching mega-menu__link (without --parent) containing the span text 'Bags & leather goods'. The call log reveals the actual failing locator is looking for a non-parent link with that text inside #submenu-1. The likely cause is either (a) "Bags & leather goods" does not exist as a sub-item under the Men mega-menu column in #submenu-1, or (b) the selector incorrectly excludes mega-menu__link--parent when the "Bags & leather goods" heading is itself a parent-level link (just like "New In"), meaning [not(contains(@class,'mega-menu__link--parent'))] filters it out.

  • The error is in the YAML test file, not the website code — do **not** modify theme HTML.
  • The call log shows the real failing locator targets Bags & leather goods with [not(contains(@class,'mega-menu__link--parent'))]; based on the live HTML pattern for "New In", column headings use the mega-menu__link--parent class, so this exclusion incorrectly filters them out.
  • Update every "column heading" assertion in this test that uses [not(contains(@class,'mega-menu__link--parent'))] — replace with either no class filter or the mega-menu__link--parent filter, whichever matches the actual DOM for each item.
  • Also fix the extra whitespace in the span text: 'Bags & leather goods' (double space) should be 'Bags & leather goods' (single space), or use normalize-space() consistently to make it whitespace-agnostic.
  • After updating selectors, confirm the mega-menu is in its expanded/visible state (hover trigger fired) before these assertions run, to ensure #submenu-1 is actually rendered in the DOM at assertion time.
